content.instructions: To perform a calculation, enter the required variables. Once all the inputs are entered, click the "Calculate" button to perform the calculation. Any time an input variable is adjusted, the "Calculate" button must be clicked to populate the new output. To start over, click the "Reset" button to clear all values and begin the calculation again. Use with caution and titrate slowly in patients with hepatic impairment; use of treprostinil has not been studied in patients with severe hepatic impairment. Treprostinil SUBQ Rate: SUBQ Infusion Rate (mL/hour) = [Dose (ng/kg/minute) x Dosing Weight (kg) x 0.00006] / Vial Strength (mg/mL) Treprostinil IV Rate: When using an appropriate infusion pump and reservoir, an IV rate should first be selected to allow for a desired infusion period length of up to 48 hours between system changeovers. Reservoir changes are typically made every 24 hours or every 48 hours to keep time of day consistent. Typical IV infusion system reservoirs have volumes of 50 or 100 mL. IV Rate (mL/hour) = Reservoir Volume (mL) / Frequency of Reservoir Change (hours) Diluted IV Treprostinil Concentration: Using the above IV Infusion Rate (mL/hour) and the patient’s dose and weight, the diluted IV treprostinil concentration is calculated using the following formula: Concentration (mg/mL) = [Dose (ng/kg/minute) x Dosing Weight (kg) x 0.00006] / IV Rate (mL/hour) Amount of Treprostinil Needed: The amount of treprostinil injection needed to make the above calculated concentration of diluted The amount of treprostinil injection needed to make the above calculated concentration of diluted treprostinil for the given reservoir size is calculated using the following formula: Amount of treprostinil injection (mL) = [Treprostinil concentration (mg/mL) / Treprostinil vial strength (mg/mL)] x Reservoir volume (mL)
